title: 🔢 Numbers & How much? / How many?
description: Учим числа 21-100, учимся покупать сувениры и читаем смешную историю о неудачном шопинге. Уровень A0. 6 дней.

days.title: Day 1: Numbers 21-50
days.description: Учим числа от двадцати одного до пятидесяти

grammar.title: Numbers 21-50
grammar.rule:
Числа от 21 до 99 образуются просто: десятки + единицы через дефис.

📌 20 — twenty
📌 21 — twenty-one
📌 22 — twenty-two
📌 30 — thirty (не three-ty!)
📌 40 — forty (не four-ty!)
📌 50 — fifty (не five-ty!)

🎯 Лайфхак: Запомни исключения — thirty, forty, fifty, а остальные пишутся по правилу!
🎯 Мем: 'How much money do I have? Twenty... actually, two.' 😂
examples: Leo: 'I have twenty-three euros. Enough for pizza!' 🍕
Mia: 'There are thirty students in my class.' 👥
Sam: 'My phone battery is at forty-two percent. It's fine.' 📱
The answer is forty-four. No, it's forty-five! Math is hard.' 🤯
grammar.keywords: twenty, thirty, forty, fifty, numbers, twenty-one, twenty-two

vocabulary.example: My mum is thirty years old.

exercises.question: What is 30 in English? 🔢
What is 21 in English? 🔢
20 + 20 = ___ (forty / fifty)
___ is 50 in English. (fifty / sixty)
Thirty is 13.

days.title: Day 2: Numbers 51-100
days.description: Учим числа от пятидесяти одного до ста

grammar.title: Numbers 51-100
grammar.rule:
Продолжаем учить числа! Тот же принцип: десятки + единицы через дефис.

📌 60 — sixty
📌 70 — seventy
📌 80 — eighty (одна буква 't'!)
📌 90 — ninety
📌 100 — one hundred

🎯 Лайфхак: Запомни — eighty пишется с одной 't' (не eight-ty, а eighty)!
examples: Leo: 'I have sixty-three problems, but maths ain't one!' 🎤
Mia: 'Seventy-eight percent on my test. Not bad!' 📝
Sam: 'Eighty-four unread texts? I need to check my phone!' 📱
The temperature is ninety-nine degrees. I'm melting!' 🥵
grammar.keywords: sixty, seventy, eighty, ninety, one hundred, numbers

vocabulary.example: My grandma is seventy years old.
I have one hundred problems, but my phone isn't one.
vocabulary.context_example: У меня сто проблем, но телефон не одна из них.

exercises.question: What is 80 in English? 🔢

grammar.title: Shopping for souvenirs — Vocabulary
grammar.rule:
В сувенирном магазине тебе пригодятся эти фразы и слова:

🛍️ souvenir — сувенир
💰 How much is it? — Сколько это стоит?
💷 It's ... pounds/euros/dollars — Это стоит ... фунтов/евро/долларов
💳 I'd like to buy... — Я хотел(а) бы купить...
🎁 key ring — брелок
🧸 teddy bear — плюшевый мишка
☕ mug — кружка
🧢 cap — кепка
👕 T-shirt — футболка

🎯 Вопрос продавца: 'Can I help you?' — Могу я вам помочь?
🎯 Ответ: 'Yes, please. I'd like to buy a souvenir.'
examples: Leo: 'How much is this key ring?' 💰
Mia: 'I'd like to buy a mug with London on it.' ☕🇬🇧
grammar.keywords: souvenir, key ring, mug, T-shirt, cap, teddy bear, how much, I'd like to buy

vocabulary.example: I want to buy a souvenir from London.
vocabulary.context_example: Я хочу купить сувенир из Лондона.

vocabulary.example: This key ring is from Paris.
I drink tea from my souvenir mug.
vocabulary.context_example: Я пью чай из своей сувенирной кружки.
На этой футболке написано 'Я люблю Лондон'.

vocabulary.example: My little sister loves teddy bears.
vocabulary.context_example: Моя маленькая сестра любит плюшевых мишек.

vocabulary.example: What is the price of this mug?

exercises.question: What do you ask to know the cost of something? 💰
exercises.explanation: 'How much is it?' — Сколько это стоит?

exercises.question: What do you say when you want to buy something? 🛍️
exercises.explanation: 'I'd like to buy...' — Я хотел(а) бы купить...

exercises.question: I want to buy a ___ from London. (сувенир)
How much is this ___? (кружка)
A teddy bear is a type of food.
exercises.explanation: A teddy bear is a soft toy, not food! 🧸

days.title: Day 4: Souvenir Shop Dialogue
days.description: Учимся вести диалог в сувенирном магазине

grammar.title: Shopping Dialogue
grammar.rule:
Типичный диалог в сувенирном магазине:

🛍️ Seller: 'Can I help you?'
😊 Customer: 'Yes, please. I'd like to buy a souvenir.'
🛍️ Seller: 'How about this key ring?'
😊 Customer: 'How much is it?'
🛍️ Seller: 'It's five euros.'
😊 Customer: 'OK. I'll take it. Here you are.'
🛍️ Seller: 'Thank you. Have a nice day!'

🎯 Вопросы продавца:
• Can I help you?
• How about this one?
• Anything else?

🎯 Фразы покупателя:
• I'd like to buy...
• How much is it?
• I'll take it.
• Here you are.
examples: Seller: 'Can I help you?' Leo: 'Yes, I'd like to buy a mug.' ☕
Seller: 'How about this one? It's ten euros.' Leo: 'Hmm, too expensive. How about this key ring?' 🔑
Seller: 'It's three euros.' Leo: 'Great! I'll take it. Here you are.' 💰
grammar.keywords: Can I help you?, I'd like to buy, How much is it?, I'll take it, Here you are

vocabulary.example: This key ring costs five euros.
This is a gift for my mum.

exercises.question: What does the seller say first? 🛍️
exercises.explanation: Продавец обычно начинает с: 'Can I help you?' — Могу я вам помочь?

exercises.question: What do you say when you want to pay? 💰
exercises.explanation: Сначала спрашиваешь цену, потом говоришь 'I'll take it', потом 'Here you are' (вот, пожалуйста) при оплате.

exercises.question: This T-shirt is 50 euros. It's very ___ . (expensive / cheap)
This key ring is 1 euro. It's ___ . (expensive / cheap)
'I'll take it' means you want to buy it.
exercises.explanation: Yes! 'I'll take it' — 'Я беру это' (согласие купить)

days.title: Day 6: Reading — The Worst Souvenir Ever (Диалог в магазине)
days.description: Читаем смешную историю о покупке сувенира

grammar.title: Reading: The Worst Souvenir Ever
grammar.rule: Сегодня читаем историю о том, как Самуил купил самый странный сувенир в мире.

exercises.question: Where did Sam want to buy a souvenir? 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁳󠁣󠁴󠁿
exercises.explanation: Sam is on holiday in Edinburgh, Scotland.
exercises.readingText:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🛍️ THE WORST SOUVENIR EVER
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📍 SCENE: A souvenir shop in Edinburgh, Scotland. Sam is on holiday with his family.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🛍️ SELLER: Good afternoon! Can I help you?

😎 SAM: Yes, please. I'd like to buy a souvenir.

🛍️ SELLER: Of course! We have key rings, mugs, T-shirts, caps, and teddy bears.

😎 SAM: How much is this key ring? (points to a key ring with a Scottish flag)

🛍️ SELLER: That's three pounds.

😎 SAM: Hmm. That's cheap. But I want something SPECIAL.

🛍️ SELLER: Special? How about this? (holds up a stuffed Nessie — the Loch Ness Monster)

😎 SAM: A stuffed monster? How much is it?

🛍️ SELLER: It's twenty-five pounds.

😎 SAM: Twenty-five? That's expensive! But... it's funny. I'll take it!

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

(Later, at the hotel)

👩 MUM: Sam, what did you buy?

😎 SAM: A souvenir of Nessie! (shows the stuffed monster)

👩 MUM: How much was it?

😎 SAM: Twenty-five pounds.

👩 MUM: TWENTY-FIVE POUNDS?! For a stuffed toy?

😎 SAM: But it's NESSIE! The Loch Ness Monster!

👩 MUM: Sam, Nessie isn't real.

😎 SAM: (gasps) WHAT?!

👩 MUM: It's a legend. A story. Like... a fairy tale.

😎 SAM: (looks at the stuffed monster) So... I paid twenty-five pounds for a fake monster?

👩 MUM: Yes, Sam.

😎 SAM: (whispers to Nessie) 'You lied to me, Nessie.' 😭

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

(Back in the shop the next day)

😎 SAM: Excuse me. Can I return this?

🛍️ SELLER: Is there something wrong with it?

😎 SAM: Yes. It's not a real monster.

🛍️ SELLER: (stares at Sam) Sir... it's a toy.

😎 SAM: I know that NOW!

🛍️ SELLER: I'm sorry, sir. No returns on souvenirs.

😎 SAM: (looks at Nessie) 'Congratulations, Nessie. You ruined my holiday budget.' 💸

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

😎 SAM (to Nessie, in the hotel room): 'This is my life now. Sleeping with a fake monster I paid twenty-five pounds for.'

(holds up Nessie) 'But you ARE cute. I guess we're friends now.' 🤝

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
